summary: Think about all the energy that must go into tracking you across social media silos, spitting out algorithms based on your only move. Why not just have a tiny little website. Sure the energy difference is small, but should that matter? It is a crisis.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Think about all the energy that must go into tracking you across social media silos, spitting out algorithms based on your only move. Why not just have a tiny little website. Sure the energy difference is small, but should that matter? It is a crisis.
